import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b=params[0],params[1]
    g = 1-np.exp(-a*t**b)
    return (params[2]*g + params[3]*P + params[4]*P**2 + params[5]*P**3 + params[6]*t*P
            + params[7]*g*t*P**2 + params[8]*g*P**3 + params[9]*t*P**2)
